seed: Layers turn about X and Y and move in depth (2.5D model and renderer), at Next defaults with no flag changed: a recording opens, a box is drawn on it at one second, Rotation Y is picked from Animate a property (its new 3D group), and a second later 180 is typed into it, so the box flips over a second. Photographed flat, then a quarter, a half and three quarters of the way through the flip, still picked, so the blue outline has to sit on the card the camera sees, narrower at its far edge, and at the end showing its back.

steps.note: Animate a property on a box drawn on a recording lists a 3D group: Rotation X, Rotation Y, Depth and Pivot depth
at two seconds the box has flipped all the way over: it shows its back, the same size, and the outline is on it
a quarter of the way through the flip: the box swings its right edge away, so that edge is shorter than the left, and the blue outline follows the narrowed card
half way through the flip in time: Ease in out has already carried it past edge on, so it shows its back, still narrower at the far edge
three quarters of the way in time: nearly all the way over, showing its back almost flat again
